summary: Add and validate a data-derived pre-delivery size-brand-to-Moderate operational funnel gate.

Added contract 2026-09-15.1 with four privacy-safe transcript-derived pre-delivery journeys, fail-closed stage evidence, separate operational technical health, combined absolute token budget, and redacted review export on branch feat/runtime-v7-operational-funnel-evaluator-20260915 from 399fcb8.
All 1862 repository tests passed after the evaluator change; changed-file Ruff checks and operational definition digests also passed.
Cloud Run staging revision gulong-chatbot-runtime-staging-00467-t7x served release and Git SHA 639a0c3 at 100 percent in staging return-only mode.

Hardened four-scenario staging diagnostic demonstrated typed city completion and complete-location negative control, but the contact-fallback scenario did not offer contact after explicit location uncertainty. Operational technical evidence covered 8 responses, 40 model calls, 679164 tokens, zero HTTP/runtime/tool errors, p50 32507 ms and p95 44173 ms. The guided expectation was then refined to require an explicit customer request before buttons.

Corrected guided scenario passed product selection, explicit installation-area request, validated province and city actions, canonical validated-choice location, and planned Moderate. It used 5 responses, 24 model calls, 453297 tokens, zero HTTP/runtime/tool errors, p50 29766 ms and p95 69151 ms; the latter is a latency concern above 45000 ms but below the 95000 ms failure bound.

The operational funnel is not yet promotion-green: current staging supports 3 of 4 intended paths across corrected targeted evidence, while contact fallback remains a correctness blocker. Actual ManyChat delivery, BigQuery landing, production abandonment, and linked 7/14-day bookings were outside this synthetic evaluation.
Final post-hardening validation passed all 1863 repository tests and changed-file Ruff checks; this supersedes the earlier 1862-test count.
